name: Stouffer's Classics Macaroni & Cheese (Single-Serve Comfort Tray)
whyItWorks: Enriched semolina elbow macaroni smothered in real cheddar cheese sauce. Soft, pillowy pasta provides gentle calories during weight-loss recovery with zero roughage, nuts, or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 5 minutes. Take a lactase tablet for the cheddar/whey sauce.
watchOuts: Contains dairy milk and cheese; enjoy in moderate single-serve portions.
